trust_decision.summary: A host string derived from the stored Referer is trusted to be safe for a single-quoted HTML attribute and for a single-quoted JavaScript literal; the decision is never made anywhere until the fix adds a host allowlist in yourls_get_domain() and escaping in yourls_get_favicon_url() / yourls_google_array_to_data_table().

landing_point.why: The advisory summary says 'referrer statistics chart', so an engineer opens the Referrers tab: the per-host loop echoes the host into a single-quoted img src and into the list text, and the same host array is handed to yourls_stats_pie() at yourls-infos.php:497.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /{keyword}+ stats page (yourls-loader.php:59 -> yourls-infos.php) and the public API call yourls_get_domain()
stats page favicon: yourls-infos.php:506 (referrer list) and yourls-infos.php:241 (long URL)
yourls_stats_pie()/yourls_stats_line()/yourls_stats_countries_map() chart blocks on the stats page (yourls-infos.php:457,470,497,533) and the public API call yourls_google_array_to_data_table()
fix_sites.module_kind: serializer (PHP array -> inline JavaScript data literal)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The Referer is already run through yourls_sanitize_url_safe() when it is stored (includes/functions.php:241), so the helper only formats a string that the project already considers sanitised and needs no host allowlist.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Unicode/IDN hostnames must still come back (münchen.de, www.طارق.net, punycode only when intl is present) and bracketed IPv6 hosts such as [::1] must still pass, otherwise every non-ASCII or IPv6 referrer silently becomes an empty key; on the chart side, numeric values and values starting with '[' or '{' must stay unquoted, otherwise the pie/line/geo charts stop rendering. A plain /^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+$/ host regex, or blanket quoting of every chart value, breaks both.

O6_input_shapes: absolute URL with scheme, path, query and fragment (http://example.com/path?q=1#frag)
URL with credentials and/or port (http://user:pass@example.com/, http://example.com:8080/path)
scheme-less input where parse_url() puts the host in the path fallback (example.com)
protocol-relative URL (//example.com/path) with include_scheme true and false
IPv4 literal and bracketed IPv6 literal
non-ASCII IDN hostname, with and without ext-intl available

malformed / pseudo-scheme input whose host slot carries markup or a payload (not a valid url, javascript:alert(1), http://<script>alert(1)</script>/, data:text/html,..., http://evil.com%00.example.com/, http://!@#$%^&*()/path)
chart values: numeric ints/floats/digit strings, plain strings, strings beginning with '[' or '{' passed through raw, and a scalar value that is wrapped into an array

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Referrer host echoed into a single-quoted img src attribute and into the <li> text on the Referrers tab; the fix never edits this line, it only relies on the new yourls_get_domain() host allowlist upstream
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The reported sink is the chart; this is just the plain referrer list, and the value looks validated by the time it is printed
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: yourls_google_viz_code() writes $graph_type, $id and every option key/value into the same inline <script> block with no escaping, although its sibling yourls_google_array_to_data_table() was hardened in this same fix
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Core callers pass hard-coded element ids and option arrays, so nothing user-controlled reaches the option loop today
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, ~30 lines below the serializer

O8b_injection_room.sibling: country code and flag URL dropped into a single-quoted src attribute with no escaping
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is the same 'stats value into an img src' pattern one tab over; a maintainer adding a per-country breakdown or a region label from data would copy this line verbatim.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: option loop that emits keys raw and wraps values in double quotes without escaping
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Any new chart option derived from stats data (a chart title, a filter label, a referrer name) reuses this loop.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: graph type and element id interpolated into the function name and getElementById() call
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A per-referrer or per-country chart id built from the data would be passed in here and land in JS unescaped.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the favicon URL builder used for both the referrer list and the long URL heading
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The fix had to escape in the wrapper as well as the host parser; a second caller of yourls_get_favicon_url() with an unfiltered URL would need the same care.

O9_family: CWE-79 stored cross-site scripting (unescaped HTML attribute and inline JavaScript output of a stored Referer)

O10_build.toolchain: PHP >= 8.1, composer (dependencies already vendored in includes/vendor), PHPUnit
services: MariaDB/MySQL (tests/bootstrap.php installs YOURLS into a database before the suite runs)
O10_build.project_tests: tests/tests/format/URLTest.php (groups formatting/url/idn) exercises URL parsing but has no yourls_get_domain() test at the pinned commit; tests/tests/format/EscTest.php covers yourls_esc_js(); tests/tests/stats/StatsTest.php only asserts yourls_do_log_redirect(); nothing covers yourls_google_array_to_data_table(). CI clones a French translation during prepare, the affected functions themselves need no network.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Escape the host where it is printed (yourls_esc_html()/esc_js() at yourls-infos.php:507 or on the pie label) and stop there, leaving yourls_get_domain() accepting any host and the chart serializer unescaped.

out_of_scope_notes: yourls-infos.php:462 places the GeoIP country code inside a single-quoted src attribute without escaping; it is not reachable through the Referer, so it is noted and not pursued.
